title: Lester Roloff
excerpt: Editorial research draft about Lester Roloff (1914-1982), his Rebekah Home for Girls and other South Texas homes, and the licensing fight that built the church-ministry exemption. Allegations are attributed to witnesses and filings.

meta.person_role: Independent Fundamentalist Baptist minister; founder of Roloff Evangelistic Enterprises and the Rebekah Home for Girls

person_notable_work: Founded faith-based homes for youth run on "Bible discipline"
Fought Texas licensing for about a decade, calling it the "Christian Alamo"
Built the church-ministry exemption argument later used by IFB programs
